reason: Unsweetened yerba mate sounds like bitter grass tea to me, and I'm not paying 55 crowns to find out when I get pre-workout or energy cans from GymBeam for much less. 80 mg of caffeine isn't more kick than what I already drink before training.
objection: It will taste bitter and grassy with no sugar, and at 55 CZK a can it costs more than my usual energy drink without giving me more energy.
would_change_my_mind: Trying a free sample at my lunch bistro and finding it actually tastes good, or seeing it on Vilgain or GymBeam in a multipack at around 35 CZK a can.
